direct_answer: Aker BP states that it does not have a climate change mitigation transition plan that is in line with ESRS requirements, because it has no targets to reduce Scope 3 emissions [Source 1]. Consequently, it does not disclose that such a transition plan is aligned with limiting global warming to 1.5°C [Source 1]. Aker BP also explicitly states it does not have a timeline for if or when it will develop such a plan [Source 1].
compliance_rationale: ESRS E1-1 requires disclosure of a transition plan and, if absent, a timeline for adopting one. Aker BP discloses it does not have an ESRS-aligned climate transition plan and that it has no timeline to develop one [Source 1]. The passages provided do not evidence an explanation of 1.5°C alignment of a transition plan (since the plan is not in place) [Source 1]. Additionally, Aker BP notes its climate-related targets are not science-based [Source 6], which further limits evidence for 1.5°C compatibility under ESRS E1-4.
disclosure_gaps: A transition plan for climate change mitigation that meets ESRS E1-1 requirements (Aker BP states it does not have one) [Source 1].

Explanation of how the undertaking’s GHG emission reduction targets/transition plan are compatible with limiting warming to 1.5°C (not provided for a transition plan; no ESRS-aligned plan exists) [Source 1].
Timeline for adopting an ESRS-aligned transition plan (explicitly not provided) [Source 1].

Evidence that GHG reduction targets are science-based and compatible with 1.5°C, including methodology/scenarios and external assurance as per ESRS E1-4 (targets stated as not science-based; not externally assured) [Source 6].
key_findings: Aker BP reports it has no Scope 3 reduction targets and therefore does not have a climate transition plan in line with ESRS requirements [Source 1].
Aker BP reports it does not have a timeline for if or when it will develop such an ESRS-aligned climate transition plan [Source 1].
Aker BP discloses its climate-related targets are not science-based and are not externally assured [Source 6].
